name: Glasgow Favourites Evening V 2026

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information: ## Please read the [Favourites Competition Format tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowFavEveningV2026#69541-favourites-competition-format) before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition. ##### Please be aware that this is an evening competition and does not begin until 5:35pm ### The competition will run in 3 groups. You will compete in one group, help out in another group, and have time for a break in a third. ### You MUST be present for the group you are helping out in otherwise you will not be allowed to compete. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.
